scope: 2020–2025 archived regular-season Weeks 1–14 and 2026 Weeks 1–7, with incomplete 2020/2021 week coverage where applicable; postseason excluded

method.scheduleSwap: For target T on schedule owner S in a given week, T keeps actual scored points and faces the opponent who played S. If that opponent is T, replace the opponent with S itself (reciprocal opponent), avoiding self-play. When either target or schedule owner lacks a recorded matchup that week, omit that week.
method.sos: Average actual points scored by scheduled opponents; higher is harder. Bye/missing matchups omitted.
method.allPlay: Compare team's weekly score against every other scored team in that league week; ties count as 0.5. Expected wins are sum of weekly all-play winning percentage, normalized to one win opportunity per recorded week.
method.luck: Actual wins (ties count as 0.5) minus all-play expected wins. Positive means favorable results relative to league-wide scoring, negative means unfavorable. Model is descriptive, not causal.
